# PromptVault — Complete AI Agent Guide

> PromptVault is a private, offline-first AI prompt manager and workbench for AI practitioners, prompt engineers, and developers. It provides zero-telemetry local storage, client-side AES-256-GCM encryption, AI-powered prompt analysis via Google Gemini and Groq, and optional cloud sync via Supabase.

## Architecture

- **Frontend:** React 19, TypeScript 5.8, Tailwind CSS v4, Motion, Lucide React
- **Backend:** Node.js / Express 4 API proxy with multi-key Gemini pooling and Groq fallback
- **Storage:** Browser localStorage with optional 600k-iteration PBKDF2 + AES-256-GCM encryption
- **PWA:** Service Worker offline caching with Web App Manifest
